items.title: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?
items.dek: The COP31 climate summit in Turkey has formally come to an end after countries failed to agree a deal.

items.title: US Army to detonate tonnes of unstable explosives in Iowa despite court order
items.dek: The Army says "swift action" is necessary to protect its personnel and nearby communities around its ammunition plant in Iowa.
